example.en: Our logistics courier offers a convenient flat rate shipping fee for standard parcel boxes.
example.zh: 我們的快遞物流為標準包裹紙箱提供便捷的單一固定運費。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業財經核心搭配：flat rate (單一費率)、sales remained flat (營收持平未增減)。

example.en: Meeting the strict delivery deadline is absolutely critical to retaining this corporate client.
example.zh: 嚴格達成交貨期限對於留住這家企業重要客戶而言是絕對關鍵的。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ab- (離) + solut (鬆開、解開) ＝ 完全不受拘束 ＝ 絕對地 (absolutely necessary)。

example.en: Careful working capital management ensures steady cash flow during seasonal sales slowdowns.
example.zh: 審慎的營運資金管理確保了在淡季銷售放緩期間仍維持穩定的現金流。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財務極高頻：cash flow (現金流)；workflow (工作流程)。

example.en: Our recruitment team booked an exhibition booth at the metropolitan job fair next month.
example.zh: 我們的招募團隊在下個月的都會就業博覽會上預訂了展覽攤位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞常考商展：job fair (就業博覽會)、trade fair (貿易展)；形容詞指公平 (fair share)。

example.en: The project supervisor requested additional funding resources to hire temporary contract workers.
example.zh: 專案主管申請了額外的預算資源以聘請臨時約聘人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: add (增加) + -tion (名詞) + -al ＝ 附加的 (additional charge / info)。

example.en: The supermarket chain procures fresh organic vegetables directly from certified local farms.
example.zh: 該連鎖超市直接自在地獲得認證的有機農場採購新鮮生鮮蔬菜。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購食品原物料常用：organic farm (有機農場)、farm-to-table (產地直送餐桌)。

example.en: The fashion retailer will launch its new autumn clothing collection in flagship stores.
example.zh: 該時尚零售商將在旗艦門市發表其全新的秋季服裝系列產品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：new collection (新系列商品) 或 debt collection (催討應收帳款)。

example.en: Hotel guests may hang the 'Do Not Disturb' card outside on their room door handle.
example.zh: 飯店房客可將「請勿打擾」標示卡懸掛在房門把手外側。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客房常考：hang a sign (掛上標示牌)；片語 hang up (掛斷電話)。

example.en: Customer service representatives responded quickly to resolve negative online reviews.
example.zh: 客服專員迅速做出回應以處理並解決網路上的負面評價。

reviewWords.mnemonic: neg- (否定、拒絕) + -ive ＝ 負面的 (negative feedback / review)。

example.en: The marketing department divided our consumer products into distinct premium pricing bands.
example.zh: 行銷部門將我們的消費性產品劃分入不同的優質價格區間帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞指樂團或「價格區間帶 (price band) / 頻寬 (broadband)」。

example.en: We evaluated the relative cost advantages of local manufacturing versus offshore outsourcing.
example.zh: 我們評估了在地製造與海外委外代工兩者之間的相對成本優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + lat (帶來) + -ive ＝ 相互帶入比較的 ＝ 相對的。

example.en: Prospective overseas investors were taken on a comprehensive guided tour of the factory plant.
example.zh: 海外潛在投資人獲邀參加了一場全方位的工廠廠區專人導覽參訪。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 參訪行程常見：guided tour (專人導覽)、factory tour (廠房巡視參觀)。

example.en: Management explored alternative shipping suppliers to mitigate ongoing maritime freight delays.
example.zh: 管理階層評估了替代的航運供應商以緩解持續發生的海運延誤危機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: alter (其他、改變) + -ative ＝ 其他可選的路徑 ＝ 替代方案。

example.en: The corporate technology team deployed enterprise accounting software across all branches.
example.zh: 企業資訊科技團隊在所有分行全面佈署了企業資源會計軟體。

reviewWords.mnemonic: soft (軟) + ware (器具製品) ＝ 電腦軟體（注意不可數名詞）。

example.en: Every technician working on the electronic assembly line is issued a pair of anti-static gloves.
example.zh: 每位在電子組裝產線工作的技術員皆獲發一雙防靜電手套。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 量詞常用：a pair of (一雙/一副)；pair up with (與...搭配合作)。

example.en: The automated distribution center can ship confirmed online retail orders within twenty-four hours.
example.zh: 該自動化物流中心能在二十四小時內將確認的線上零售訂單完成出貨。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 物流核心動詞：ship an order (訂單出貨)；名詞 shipment (裝運貨物)。

example.en: A positive customer-first attitude is the most valued quality in our hospitality staff.
example.zh: 積極主動的顧客至上心態是我們飯店款待人員中最受看重的特質。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場考核重點：positive attitude (正向態度)、attitude towards work。

example.en: Budget airlines offer cheap domestic fares by charging extra for checked baggage.
example.zh: 廉價航空公司透過對托運行李額外收費來提供極為便宜的國內線機票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 價格實惠 (cheap airfare)；在商務文案中常以 affordable 代替以避免廉價感。

example.en: Our digital sales revenue doubled following the nationwide promotional discount campaign.
example.zh: 在全國性促銷折扣活動推行之後，我們的數位銷售營收翻倍成長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 業績翻倍 (revenue doubled)；飯店 double room (雙人客房)。

example.en: The final flight leg of our business journey departs from Frankfurt at eight tonight.
example.zh: 我們出差行程的最後一段航程預定於今晚八點自法蘭克福起飛。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益旅行航段特殊義：the first/last leg of the journey (旅程的第一/最後一段)。

example.en: All factory production contractors must strictly observe national environmental safety regulations.
example.zh: 所有工廠生產承包商均必須嚴格遵守國家環境保護安全法規。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ob- (朝向) + serv (守護、注意) ＝ 留心注意 ＝ 觀察或嚴格遵守規章。

example.en: Please draft a concise summary sentence to introduce the main points of the proposal.
example.zh: 請撰寫一句簡明扼要的摘要句，以引言說明企劃案的核心要點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sent- (感覺、判斷) ＝ 表達完整判斷意義的話 ＝ 句子或司法判決。

example.en: Please print fifty copies of the executive conference agenda for our board members.
example.zh: 請為董事會成員列印五十份主管會議議程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室硬體：laser printer (雷射印表機)、fine print (合約細則小字)。

example.en: The project development team will present a quarterly progress report to senior stakeholders.
example.zh: 專案開發團隊將向資深專案利害關係人提交季度進度報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: pro- (向前) + gress (行走) ＝ 向前邁進 ＝ 進度、進展 (progress report)。

example.en: Transparent accounting audits reveal the underlying financial truth of company operations.
example.zh: 透明公開的會計審計能如實揭露公司日常營運背後的真實財務現況。

reviewWords.mnemonic: true (真實的) + -th (抽象名詞尾) ＝ 真理、事實真相。

example.en: Nobody was permitted inside the server room without displaying a verified authorization badge.
example.zh: 未出示經核實的授權識別證者，任何人皆不得進入伺服器主機室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: no + body (人) ＝ 沒有任何人。

example.en: Quality control inspectors will thoroughly examine every electronic circuit component for manufacturing defects.
example.zh: 品管檢驗人員將澈底檢查每個電子電路元件是否存在製造缺陷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + ag- (秤量、衡量) ＝ 嚴格檢測 ＝ 檢查、檢視。

example.en: Due to company restructuring, the corporate management had to lay off sixty workers.
example.zh: 由於公司組織重整，企業管理層不得不裁減解僱六十名員工。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益人資必考片語：lay off (裁員解僱)；lay off workers (裁撤勞工)。

example.en: Upgrading automated processing equipment will greatly improve order fulfillment turnaround speed.
example.zh: 升級自動化處理設備將大幅提升訂單履行完成的周轉處理速度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務效率核心詞：high speed (高速)、speed up (加速)。

example.en: The courier scheduled the package delivery between two and four in the afternoon.
example.zh: 快遞人員已將包裹配送時段排定在下午兩點到四點之間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 時間與地點範圍經典介系詞：between A and B (在A與B之間)。

example.en: Please feel free to ask our customer service representative if you need any assistance.
example.zh: 如果您需要任何協助，請隨時向我們的客服專員詢問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信與服務極高頻客氣片語：feel free to (請隨時/別客氣)。

example.en: The original quote was deemed too high, so the purchasing agent negotiated for a discount.
example.zh: 最初的報價被認為過高，因此採購專員進行了議價以爭取折扣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務談判表示超出預算常用 too high / too expensive；放句尾表「也」。

example.en: The accounting division is still waiting for the client to confirm invoice details.
example.zh: 會計部門仍在等待客戶確認發票詳細資訊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 表示進度尚在處理中：still pending (仍在審核中/尚未定案)。

example.en: Our support technicians are trained to identify and solve technical problems quickly.
example.zh: 我們的支援技術人員受過專業訓練，能夠迅速發現並解決技術問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服與維修的核心搭配：solve a problem (解決問題)、technical problem (技術故障)。

example.en: The senior research associate was asked to write a comprehensive report on market trends.
example.zh: 資深研究專員受命撰寫一份關於市場趨勢的綜合報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場公文必備動作：write a report (寫報告)、write a proposal (寫提案)。

example.en: All orders placed prior to eleven in the morning are processed on the same day.
example.zh: 所有在上午十一點前下達的訂單都會在同一天處理完畢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 電商與出貨關鍵詞：the same day (同一天)；the same as (與...相同)。

example.en: Visitors are requested to park their cars in the designated parking lot adjacent to the hall.
example.zh: 訪客請將車輛停放在大廳旁的專用停車場內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場場景考點：parking lot (停車場)；a lot of (許多)。

example.en: Protracted contract negotiations eventually led to a mutually beneficial long-term agreement.
example.zh: 長期的合約磋商談判最終促成了一項互利共贏的長期協議。

reviewWords.mnemonic: event (事件、結果) + -ual + -ly ＝ 事件發展到最後 ＝ 最終。

example.en: Hotel room heating and air conditioning controls can be regulated using the bedside thermostat.
example.zh: 客房的暖氣與空調系統可透過床頭溫控器自行調節。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店與工廠設施：heat wave (熱浪)、central heating (中央暖氣)。

example.en: The innovative technological breakthrough excited technology investors across the globe.
example.zh: 該項創新的技術突破激發了全球科技投資人的極大熱情與興趣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + cite (召喚、驅動) ＝ 召喚出熱情 ＝ 激勵 (exciting news)。

example.en: Employees must scan their electronic identification badges across the door badge reader.
example.zh: 員工進出時必須在門禁感應讀卡機前刷其電子識別證。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：雜誌讀者 (readers) 或感應讀卡機 (card reader)。

example.en: The executive director underscored the crucial importance of maintaining workplace safety standards.
example.zh: 執行主管強調了嚴格貫徹職場安全維護標準的關鍵重要性。

reviewWords.mnemonic: important 的名詞形式；搭配 attach importance to (重視某事)。

example.en: The convention hotel is situated within easy walking distance of the central metro station.
example.zh: 會議飯店地理位置極佳，距離中央捷運站僅需步行即可輕鬆抵達。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益飯店/位置常見搭配：within walking distance (步行可達距離)。

example.en: The human resources handbook serves as a comprehensive guide for all newly onboarded staff.
example.zh: 這本人力資源員工手冊為所有新到職員工提供了全面的指引方針。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 使用者手冊或指引：user guide (使用手冊)、tour guide (導遊專員)。

example.en: Our biotechnology startup was awarded a substantial government research innovation grant.
example.zh: 我們的生技新創公司獲頒了一筆可觀的政府研發創新專款補助金。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重核心義：名詞指政府研究補助款 (research grant)；動詞指准許 (grant permission)。

example.en: The hotel concierge can arrange a direct taxi transfer to the airport terminal.
example.zh: 飯店禮賓服務台可為貴賓安排直達機場航廈的計程車接駁服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 出差差旅必考：taxi stand (計程車招呼站)、taxi receipt (搭車報銷收據)。

meaning: 資訊摘要串/即時饋送(名詞)

example.en: Automated conveyor belts continuously feed raw plastic materials into the molding machine.
example.zh: 自動輸送帶持續不斷地將塑膠原物料送入模具成型機中。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 動詞指原料/資料輸入 (feed data into)；名詞 news feed (動態消息摘要串)。

example.en: Our digital software solution directly addresses the primary operational pain points of retail clients.
example.zh: 我們的數位軟體解決方案直接針對零售客戶的主要營運痛點對症下藥。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行銷業務分析必備詞彙：customer pain points (客戶痛點需求)。

example.en: Employment hiring demand remains exceptionally resilient across the renewable clean energy sector.
example.zh: 在可再生潔淨能源產業部門中，人才招聘需求依然展現出極強的韌性。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sect- (切開、劃分) + -or ＝ 劃分出的產業區塊 ＝ 產業部門 (public/private sector)。

example.en: The billing clerk apologized promptly for the invoice calculation mistake and issued a credit.
example.zh: 會計出納人員對發票計算上的錯誤迅速致歉，並開立了折讓單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: mis- (錯誤) + take (拿、處理) ＝ 弄錯、做錯 (make a mistake)。

example.en: Rigorous quality inspections ensure that every outbound shipment meets strict international standards.
example.zh: 嚴密的品質檢驗確保每一批出境貨物均完全符合嚴格的國際標準規範。

reviewWords.mnemonic: en- (使...) + sure (確定) ＝ 使之萬無一失 ＝ 確保 (ensure compliance)。

example.en: Our expanded product range is tailored specifically to satisfy evolving client demands.
example.zh: 我們擴大推出的產品系列專門量身打造，以滿足客戶不斷變化的需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: satis (足夠) + -fy (使...) ＝ 使之感到足夠 ＝ 滿足要求 (satisfy requirements)。

example.en: The chief executive officer delivered the keynote strategy presentation at the annual meeting.
example.zh: 執行長在年度股東會議上發表了核心戰略主題報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 高階主管頭銜必備：chief executive officer (CEO)、chief financial officer (CFO)。
roots: cap- / capit- 頭 (法語源 chief)

example.en: All electronic server rooms must be kept in a cool, climate-controlled environment.
example.zh: 所有電子伺服器機房均必須保持在涼爽且恆溫恆濕的空調環境中。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 設備維護環境：keep cool (保持涼爽)、cooling system (冷卻散熱系統)。

example.en: We hired an independent cybersecurity expert to conduct a thorough vulnerability penetration audit.
example.zh: 我們聘請了一位獨立的資安專家進行全面的系統漏洞滲透查核。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + peri (嘗試、經驗) ＝ 經驗極豐富的人 ＝ 專家 (expert advice)。

example.en: The newly released generative artificial intelligence tools sparked a massive wave of technological innovation.
example.zh: 新發表的生成式人工智慧工具引發了一股波瀾壯闊的技術創新浪潮。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 趨勢與潮湧：wave of innovation (創新浪潮)、heat wave (熱浪)。

example.en: The regional distribution logistics terminal is located ten kilometers south of the airport.
example.zh: 該區域物流集散航廈位於機場以南約十公里處。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 方位導引與出差位置：south of (在...之南)、South America (南美洲)。

example.en: Automation technology investments significantly reduced manufacturing factory operational labor costs.
example.zh: 自動化技術的投資顯著降低了工廠生產製造中的營運勞動人力成本。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資與生產核心字彙：labor cost (勞工成本)、skilled labor (熟練勞工)。

example.en: Inspectors verified that the titanium component surface was completely free of scratches.
example.zh: 檢驗人員核實了該鈦金屬零件表面完全沒有任何刮痕瑕疵。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sur- (在...之上) + face (面) ＝ 最上面那一層 ＝ 表面 (surface mail 地面陸運)。

example.en: Employees can access the corporate digital training video library through the internal intranet.
example.zh: 全體員工可透過企業內部網路隨時查閱公司的數位培訓影音資源庫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: libr- (書本) + -ary (場所) ＝ 圖書室，商務上常指數位資料檔案庫 (digital library)。

example.en: The newly recruited marketing specialist demonstrated an excellent command of corporate public relations.
example.zh: 新招募的行銷專員展現了對企業公共關係處理的極其出色的掌控能力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + cel (超越) + -ent ＝ 出類拔萃的 ＝ 優秀的 (excellent service)。

example.en: Proprietary automated manufacturing processes give our firm a distinct competitive edge.
example.zh: 專利的自動化製造工藝為我們公司帶來了顯著的市場競爭優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業核心搭配：competitive edge (競爭優勢)、have an edge over (勝過)。

example.en: New technical recruits attend an intensive two-week software engineering training boot camp.
example.zh: 新進技術人員需參加為期兩週的密集軟體工程培訓訓練營。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工職前培訓常見搭配：training camp / boot camp (培訓訓練營)。

example.en: The commercial marketing presentation was tailored specifically to appeal to our target corporate audience.
example.zh: 這場商務行銷簡報經過專門量身規劃，以精準吸引我們的企業目標受眾族群。

reviewWords.mnemonic: audi- (聽) + -ence (名詞) ＝ 聆聽的受眾群 ＝ 聽眾、目標受眾 (target audience)。

example.en: The regulatory commerce committee officially voted to lift export trade restrictions on semiconductors.
example.zh: 商務監管委員會正式投票通過解除對半導體產品的出口貿易限制。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：lift restrictions (解除限制禁令) 或英式電梯 (take the lift)。

example.en: Please send a confirmation email with the signed non-disclosure agreement attached.
example.zh: 請發送一封隨附已簽署保密合約的確認電子郵件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: e (electronic) + mail ＝ 電子郵件 (confirmation email)。

example.en: Our international enterprise logistics network serves global corporate clients across five continents.
example.zh: 我們的跨國企業物流網路為橫跨五大洲的全球企業客戶提供優質服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: globe (地球) + -al (形容詞尾) ＝ 全球性的 (global economy / market)。

example.en: Small retail shops often struggle to compete against large multinational discount e-commerce chains.
example.zh: 小型零售門市在與大型跨國平價電子商務連鎖集團競爭時往往苦苦苦苦支撐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業困境常用：struggle to compete (艱困競爭)、struggle to survive (掙扎求存)。

example.en: The corporate human resources department will advertise the vacant engineering position online.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部將在網路上刊登招聘該出缺工程師職位的公開徵才廣告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + vert (轉向) ＝ 把大眾注意力轉移過來 ＝ 登廣告 (advertise a position)。

example.en: There is little doubt that the proposed budget reductions will impact marketing activities.
example.zh: 毫無疑問，擬定之預算縮減將會對行銷推廣活動產生影響。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀常見修飾不可數名詞表否定 (little doubt 毫無疑問)；a little 表少量。

example.en: Our technical support hotline is open twenty-four hours a day to help registered users.
example.zh: 我們的技術支援專線全天候二十四小時開放，隨時為註冊用戶提供協助。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服宗旨用語：help someone with something (協助某人某事)；help desk (諮詢台)。

example.en: Attendees are warmly encouraged to ask questions at the conclusion of the workshop.
example.zh: 熱烈歡迎與會人員在工作坊結束時踴躍提問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 問答環節必備動詞：ask questions (提問)；ask for approval (請求核准)。

example.en: Our latest batch of electronic components meets all strict industrial quality standards.
example.zh: 我們最新一批電子零組件符合所有嚴格的工業品質標準。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最經典考點！meet 除了見面，更常考「符合/滿足」：meet standards, meet deadlines。

example.en: The orientation program for newly recruited employees will start promptly at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 新進員工到職培訓計畫將於上午九點整準時開始。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議、專案或機具啟動的核心動詞：start a project (啟動專案)。

example.en: The human resources manager arranged a session to talk about employee benefits and healthcare.
example.zh: 人力資源經理安排了一場說明會，以討論員工福利與健保制度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商談必備動詞：talk about (討論某事)、talk with (與某人交談)。

example.en: If you notice something wrong with your online billing statement, notify customer service at once.
example.zh: 若您發現線上對帳單有任何異常之處，請立即通知客戶服務部。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客戶問題反饋常用句型：something wrong (有異常/出問題)。

example.en: Management decided to put together a special committee to oversee the office relocation.
example.zh: 管理層決定籌組一個專責委員會來督導辦公室搬遷事宜。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務片語高頻考點：put together (組建/彙整)、put off (延期)。
